name: Piper PA-11 Cub Special
summary: Later production variant of the J-3 Cub: tandem two-seat, strut-braced high-wing taildragger with a fully enclosed cowling and a shallower windshield.

wings: High wing braced by one strut per side
engines: Single small flat-four fully enclosed in a smooth cowl
fuselage: Windshield raked at a shallow angle
Fixed main gear with a tailwheel

tellTales: Classic light taildragger profile with a fully enclosed engine cowl
Tandem seats under a strut-braced high wing
Rounded, rolled-edge tail over a tailwheel

confusedWith.howToTell: The PA-11 has a fully enclosed cowling and a more sloping windshield; the J-3 often shows cylinder heads and has a more upright windshield.
The PA-11 has rounded tips and a rounded tail with a small engine; the Super Cub has squared tips, a squared fin and a bigger engine.
The PA-11 is a narrow tandem two-seater; the J-5 Cruiser has a wider cabin with a bench rear seat.
